title: Feature update deferral is very long

maxDeferralDays.text: Days a feature update may be deferred

report.title: {Items.Count} update {Plural(Items.Count, 'ring defers', 'rings defer')} feature updates for more than {params.maxDeferralDays} days

messages.businessImpact: Devices drift towards the end of their build's support, at which point the deferral stops mattering and the update becomes urgent instead of planned.
remediation: Use a feature update policy to control the target version rather than a long deferral.
